observations.content: Assistant identified the root cause of user's stuck-agent bug as a known upstream Paseo issue where extension-initiated Pi turns never settle (activeTurnId null, no turn_completed), leaving the agent running.

Assistant reframed earlier diagnosis: the precise mechanism is extension-initiated turns staying running, triggered by Phase-1 drain injections (sendMessage with subagent-message customType), steer-backs, and slash command executions rather than generic notify drop.

Fetched Paseo issue #3845 titled bug(pi): process completion wake leaves agent stuck running; symptoms: extension wakes idle agent via pi.sendMessage triggerTurn:true, resumed response ends but composer keeps spinning, persisted lastStatus stays running, daemon logs cancelAgentRun acknowledged turn still active after timeout force-canceling.
Issue #3845 reproduced with @mjakl/pi-processes 2.0.0 on Paseo 0.5.2, Pi 0.84.3, Node v24.19.0, Arch; related to issues #801, #3496/PR #3497, and #2281 in OMP provider.

Fetched Paseo issue #3847 titled Pi autonomous turns remain running after settlement; Paseo 0.5.1 macOS; explicitly names pi-subagents completion notifications using triggerTurn:true path; Paseo emits turn_started but never turn_completed, parent waiting on notifyOnFinish gets nothing; has failing regression test asserting missing turn_completed lifecycle event.
Assistant noted issue #3847 explicitly names pi-subagents completion notifications, the extension family subagent-types was ported from; user's daemon is version 0.6.1 started 12:55.
Fetched Paseo releases: latest is v0.7.0-beta.2 (2026-08-28); v0.6.1 released 2026-08-25; neither the 0.6.x nor 0.7.0-beta changelog lists the autonomous Pi turn settlement fix.

Fetched PR #3849 (fix(pi): settle autonomous Pi turns triggered by extensions) by mjakl: describes treating Pi agent lifecycle as authoritative for extension-triggered turns without a Paseo provider turn ID, deferring autonomous completion until agent_settled; marked ready for review Aug 25 17:07, still in review as of Aug 26, not yet merged.
